$comment: ProWorld Academy billing rules — the single source of truth for the backend page (BILLING constant in backend/index.html mirrors this) and for the Stripe functions. Dates are the School District of Palm Beach County 2026–27 calendar; the academy follows the school year.

monthly_plans.charge: On the 1st of each month, for that month, to the card on file (Stripe subscription anchored to the 1st).
monthly_plans.mid_month_start: Charged at sign-up for the remaining training days of the month only: price × remaining_training_days ÷ weekdays_in_month, rounded to the dollar. Full price from the next 1st. A start in a month still ahead charges nothing at sign-up: that month is billed on its own 1st, prorated from the start day (families moving over from the old system keep their paid month and are first charged on the next 1st).
monthly_plans.break_months: A month touched by a break is billed price × training_days_in_month ÷ weekdays_in_month (same formula). A month with no training days (June, July) is not billed.
monthly_plans.plan_change: Prorated the same way for the rest of the month; the new price applies from the next 1st.
monthly_plans.cancel: Any time before the 1st, from the family account (Customer Portal) or the front desk; takes effect at the end of the month already billed; no refund of the current month.

late_policy.retries: Stripe Smart Retries plus 'update your card' emails run automatically after a failed charge.
late_policy.suspend: Player cannot train until the balance is paid; attendance shows the hold.
late_policy.remove: Enrollment cancelled and the spot released; returning = pay the balance including the late fee and re-enroll (prorated from the return date).

one_time_items: Drop-ins, flex packs, lesson packages, private lessons, camps, court reservations and weekly plans are charged when booked, never on the 1st. Weekly plans (Full Time CORE / INTENSIVE weekly) are sold per week booked.

existing_policies_kept.unbooked_attendance: Charged at the program's drop-in rate to the card on file.
existing_policies_kept.flex_packages: Only for Full Time and Afterschool / U12.

training_days: Monday–Friday inside a term, excluding break weeks and any day listed in closed_days.

school_single_holidays_2026_27.$comment: Regular training days unless added to closed_days.

months_2026_27.break: Winter break from Dec 21 (last training day Dec 18)
Winter break through Jan 4 (first training day Jan 5)
Summer from May 28 (last training day May 27)
Summer — no regular tuition; summer camps separate
Summer — no regular tuition; summer camps separate
Fall 2027 start to be set from the 2027–28 school calendar

break_month_notice.when: the 25th of the month before a break month

stripe_implementation.subscription: billing_cycle_anchor = the next 1st at 06:00 ET, proration_behavior = none; a start in the current month is charged at sign-up as a one-time payment (start-month product) computed with the formula above, and the plan is created on the saved card the moment Stripe confirms it; a start in a month still ahead is anchored to that month's 1st with nothing due today, and the nightly job credits the days before the start (and the breaks) onto that first invoice.
stripe_implementation.break_month: On the 25th a job adds a negative invoice item ('Winter break credit — Dec 21–31') to the customer's pending items so the Dec 1 invoice shows the full price and the credit; months with factor 0 get the subscription paused for collection.
stripe_implementation.late_fee: On the 6th, if the month's invoice is still open: create and charge a one-off invoice 'Late fee — <month> tuition' ($50); on the 10th flag the player on hold; on the 15th cancel the subscription and release the spot.
stripe_implementation.weekly_and_one_time: One-time prices charged via Checkout or the card on file.
